name: Higher Ed Remote Job Posting Scraper

mentions.name: Higher Ed Remote Job Posting Scraper
mentions.description: This cloud-native app scrapes job postings from higher education institutions and sends a daily summary based on a set of keywords, focused on finding remote jobs offered through schools.
mentions.problem: Tracking remote job openings at higher education institutions is hard to do manually; the author's wife is looking for a remote job.
mentions.audience: Personal use for the author, whose wife is looking for a remote job.
mentions.source_excerpt: Cloud native app that scrapes job postings for higher ed institutions, then send me a daily summary based on a handful of keywords. Mostly targeting something to find remote jobs offered through schools.

evidence.value: Cloud native app that scrapes job postings for higher ed institutions, then send me a daily summary based on a handful of keywords. Mostly targeting something to find remote jobs offered through schools.
